commentary.text: 90+15' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+11' Luis Suarez (Almeria) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+11' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
90+10' The referee is firm and issues Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) a deserved yellow card.

90+9' 3 - 2 Jude Bellingham fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 3:2.
90+8' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+7' Gaizka Garitano (Almeria) receives a second yellow card and walks off the field of play!
90+6' Dion Lopy (Almeria) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+6' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francisco Maeso who sees an offensive foul.

90+5' What a chance that is! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
90+2' Almeria take a short corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
90' Joselu (Real Madrid) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
89' Real Madrid play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
87' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) is replacing Lucas Robertone.
84' Francisco Maeso shows the yellow card to Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) for a heavy challenge.
84' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
82' Substitution. Toni Kroos walks off the pitch and Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
82' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
82' The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
81' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort. Real Madrid win a corner.
81' Almeria couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Kepa Arrizabalaga (Real Madrid) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
80' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and it's Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
77' Gaizka Garitano prepares a substitution. Sergio Arribas is replaced by Lazaro (Almeria).
77' Substitution. Largie Ramazani makes his way off the pitch and Adrian Embarba (Almeria) comes on as his replacement.
77' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
75' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) for a tough tackle.
75' The attendance is 72044.
75' The game is interrupted now, Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Substitution. Luis Suarez (Almeria) in, Marko Milovanovic out.
70' Gaizka Garitano decides to make a substitution. Marc Pubill will be replaced by Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Federico Valverde cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Real Madrid players have a reason to celebrate!
69' Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

67' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
67' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' Referee Francisco Maeso halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Gaizka Garitano, then shows him a yellow.
64' A yellow card for a tackle by Dion Lopy (Almeria). Francisco Maeso doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
64' The goal by Almeria is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
63' The goal for Almeria is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
61' Goal! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
60' Joselu (Real Madrid) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
57' 1 - 2 GOAL! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Luis Maximiano in goal.
57' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
56' Referee Francisco Maeso awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
55' There's a break in play and referee Francisco Maeso must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Madrid using VAR. This could be interesting!
52' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) sees a yellow card from Francisco Maeso after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
50' Joselu (Real Madrid) is adjudged offside.
48' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carlo Ancelotti probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid). He is replaced by Fran Garcia.
46' Half-time substitution. Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) is replaced by Brahim Diaz.
46' The game is over for Rodrygo (Real Madrid). Joselu comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The resulting corner from Lucas Robertone (Almeria) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+4' A nice individual effort by Largie Ramazani (Almeria) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The ball is out of play. Almeria win a corner kick.
45+3' Almeria seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45+1' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

43' 0 - 2 Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top right corner. He makes it 0:2 with this magnificent strike.
43' A cross from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
42' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sends a long ball in, but Luis Maximiano comfortably gathers the ball.
40' The Real Madrid players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
39' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
37' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
36' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
35' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
34' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
31' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
30' A pass by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Almeria.
27' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
26' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
26' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.

24' Ambitious effort from Sergio Arribas (Almeria). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
23' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
23' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' A player from Almeria commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
20' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
17' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kepa Arrizabalaga, who smothers the ball.
15' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
14' Good defending. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to find Rodrygo inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
13' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
12' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
11' Almeria players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
10' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) passes the ball onto Ferland Mendy, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
9' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
7' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) attempts to find Jude Bellingham, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
5' Almeria control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' 0 - 1 Largie Ramazani (Almeria) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the left post.
